lines.quote: Design and implement phased-array beamforming algorithms for Boreal’s multi-aperture active imaging systems, including a 32-channel digital beamformer achieving sidelobe suppression below -25 dB for the BP-200 product
Build and maintain the production Python test and calibration framework (~12,000 lines) used across Boreal’s full product line for automated signal quality verification and regression testing

Conducted a full RF measurement and characterisation campaign for the BP-200 transmit/receive front-end, including antenna element pattern verification, transmit power calibration, and receiver noise figure measurements using Keysight PNA-X network analysers and custom optical/RF test fixtures

Apply the signal processing and electromagnetic theory from my Electrical Engineering degree at BKNU to practical product challenges throughout my work at Boreal, particularly in array processing and spectral analysis
I also have a working knowledge of Kalman filtering and estimation theory that I believe would apply to tracking and state-estimation aspects of your work.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: The cover letter explicitly states the candidate has not worked on this: “I have not worked on spaceborne or airborne instruments, and I expect there are domain standards, qualification requirements, and environmental constraints I would need to learn.” Recorded as not_stated because the fixed status vocabulary has no category for an explicit denial of experience.
